title: Stroked ellipse can't be picked/dragged at its centre — fragments into ~25 merge fill-loops, centre face pickAt returns null
description: Surfaced (documented, not fixed) by task 1331. In the merge model, a STROKED ellipse/oval commits as ~25 fragmented fill loops (the stroke segments the fill), so pickAt at the oval's CENTRE returns null and you can't select/drag the stroked oval by its interior — a stroke-free oval picks/drags fine. Likely the fragmentation of a curved stroke-bordered fill leaves the centre as many tiny faces or an unresolved region, or pickAt's face resolution at the centroid fails. EXPLORE engine/planar pickAt/locateFace + how a stroked oval folds (merge.ts / planarShapeToShape) + subselection.ts pickAt. FIX so the interior of a stroked oval (and similar stroke-bordered curved fills) resolves to its fill face for click-select/drag, matching a stroke-free oval. VERIFY: build + core/authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable); merge oracles still diff=0; add a regression test (stroked oval: pickAt at centre resolves a fill face; drag works). ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Scope: engine/planar pickAt/fold (+test).
